known_capability_boundaries: Rule induction is limited to affine Boolean/XOR and a declared numeric expression grammar.
Counterexample search only tests supplied rows.
Causal inference is limited by access, interventions, controls, model behavior and coverage.
A 4-bit finite truth-table reconstruction does not imply model-weight or LLM reconstruction.
Transformer layer APIs differ; adapter capability matrix is authoritative.
Synthetic levels 1-8 test adapter/instrumentation paths; only SYNTH-PARITY-4 has an independently validated full behavioral reconstruction.
The causal language model is a random-weight synthetic test fixture, not a pretrained or semantically competent LLM.
principles: hypothesis classes, not universal rule induction
no hidden ground truth exposed to discovery
behavioral reconstruction kept separate from mechanistic equivalence
